definitions.explanation: To convert text from one language to another.

examples.japanese: {英語|えいご}を{日本語|にほんご}に{訳|やく}す。
この{本|ほん}は{日本語|にほんご}に{訳|やく}されている。
examples.english: This book has been translated into Japanese.

examples.japanese: この{小説|しょうせつ}を{英語|えいご}に{訳|やく}すのは{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: It's difficult to translate this novel into English.

notes:
{訳|やく}す means to translate written text from one language to another.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Takes を and に particles

COMMON PATTERNS:
- AをBに{訳|やく}す: to translate A into B
- {英語|えいご}から{日本語|にほんご}に{訳|やく}す: to translate from English to Japanese
- {直訳|ちょくやく}する: to translate literally
- {意訳|いやく}する: to translate freely/liberally

RELATED WORDS:
- {翻訳|ほんやく}: translation (written)
- {通訳|つうやく}: interpretation (oral)
- {訳者|やくしゃ}: translator
- {訳文|やくぶん}: translated text
- {原文|げんぶん}: original text

DISTINCTION:
{訳|やく}す / {翻訳|ほんやく} = written translation
{通訳|つうやく} = oral interpretation (real-time)
